title: CRC loop with a UInt32 remainder
change_description: The live CRC uses a specialized natural-number fold with a UInt32 remainder instead of constructing a list of indices. The public step delegates to the same masked polynomial update; unconditional proofs retain every width and word, including the arbitrary-precision high-bit fallback. [Implementation and proof evidence](../docs/GEN11-CRC.md).
